story.iWant: to control how many items are displayed per tab
story.soThat: I can optimize for my screen size and browsing style
story.tasks: - Store preference per tab in localStorage - Format: {items_per_page: {videos: 48, papers: 24, ...}} - Update tab display logic to respect preference - Add items-per-page selector to each tab - Default: 48 items (current Videos tab behavior)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - Given I'm viewing any dashboard tab, when I select items-per-page (12, 24, 48, 96), then the display updates immediately - And my choice is saved per tab in browser storage - When I return to the tab, then my items-per-page preference is applied - And pagination controls adjust accordingly

artifacts.docs: <doc path="docs/prd.md" title="Product Requirements Document" section="Success Criteria" snippet="Dashboard Performance target: Dashboard loads in <2 seconds with 1,500+ items. Page load times, interaction responsiveness. No waiting, instant domain switching."/>

artifact.reason: Existing pagination implementation with PAGE_SIZE constant that needs to be made configurable per user preference
Video tab with fixed limit of 48 items that should become configurable per user preference
Course tab that needs items-per-page selector for optimal browsing experience
News tab where different users prefer different item densities based on reading habits
Deal tab where users may want more items per page for comparison shopping

ecosystem.name: javascript
ecosystem.packages: localStorage API, CSS Grid/Flexbox for responsive layouts

constraints.constraint: Items-per-page changes must apply instantly (<200ms) without page reload
Preference selection must be clearly visible and easily accessible on each tab
Invalid or corrupted per-tab preferences must fallback to sensible defaults
Selected items-per-page must work well across different screen sizes and devices
Items-per-page selector must be keyboard accessible with proper ARIA labels
Pagination controls must update correctly based on selected items-per-page preference

interface.name: ItemsPerPageManager
interface.signature: class ItemsPerPageManager: savePreference(tab, items), loadPreference(tab), getDefaultValue(tab)

tests.standards: UI testing for items-per-page selector and immediate content updates. localStorage testing for preference persistence across sessions. Responsive testing to verify optimal item counts across screen sizes. Performance testing to ensure sub-200ms preference application.

ideas.idea: Test: Select 24 items per page and verify content updates immediately with 24 items displayed
Test: Change preference and navigate away/back, verify per-tab preference is preserved
Test: Verify pagination controls update correctly (page numbers, next/prev buttons) based on selected items count
Test: Test each available option (12, 24, 48, 96) and verify correct content loading
Test: Verify invalid/corrupted localStorage preferences fallback to default values per tab
Test: Navigate items-per-page selector using keyboard only, verify proper focus and ARIA announcements
